description: DansUGC plugins for coding agents: turn the product in your repo into short-form UGC ads with real human creators.

plugins.name: reelclaw
plugins.description: Make TikTok/Reels UGC ads for the product in your repo: real human reaction hooks from DansUGC (or your own footage) + your demo, edited and rendered locally by your agent with the reelclaw engine (7 templates, playbook, frame-by-frame QA). Works on any DansUGC account; editing is free and only new library clips and research queries cost credits.
